definitions.gloss: to exert an influence; to have an effect on; to impact
definitions.explanation: To produce a noticeable effect or influence on something or someone. Used for both positive and negative impacts. A formal expression common in news, academic writing, and official reports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{影響|えいきょう}を{及|およ}ぼす。
⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧{影響|えいきょう}を{及|およ}ぼす{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a risk of having a negative effect on the environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{影響|えいきょう}を{及|およ}ぼす⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This policy is expected to have a major impact on the economy as a whole.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal expression frequently used in written Japanese, news, and academic contexts. The verb ⟦{及|およ}ぼす→及ぼす：02028_oyobosu⟧ specifically means to extend or reach, giving the expression a sense of influence spreading outward. Often modified with ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (good/bad) or ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧ (large) to specify the nature of the impact.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧{影響|えいきょう}を{及|およ}ぼす (to have a bad effect)
- ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{影響|えいきょう}を{及|およ}ぼす (to have a good effect)
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{影響|えいきょう}を{及|およ}ぼす (to have a major impact)
- ⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な{影響|えいきょう}を{及|およ}ぼす (to have a serious impact)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える→影響を与える：26072_eikyouwoataeru⟧: to give influence — a slightly less formal synonym
- ⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to influence — the simplest way to express this
